narrative.details:
Uh, um... h-hello, I mean to say, hi! Greetings, even! I'm sorry... its um, been so long since I've actually spoken to another person. I'm afraid I'm a bit rusty at this.

<The strange hooded figure shifts uncomfortably before you.>

So er, um... how is your day going?
narrative.objectives: Speak with the Strange Hermit in the Shadowgale Forest and learn more about him.
narrative.offerRewardText: ...that's about all I have to say about it. I was--um--somewhere else before I was here. Now I'm here and I have my friends, and my things. T-things I built, I mean. That's about all I need. I think that's all I need, anyway.I have to say though, it is nice to talk to someone who will talk back. The forest spirits try, but they just end up singing at me. That's nice in its own way, but not exactly s-stimulating conversation.
